pages.text: A Router links XNet Controller networks. To share a channel, name it in the Controller, then give it a published name in the Router. Channels with the same published name and type can connect.

For a local Controller network, run colored Network Cable to a matching Connector against the Router.$(br2)To link this Router to another Router or a Wireless Router, place a Routing Connector at each end and join them with Routing Network Cable.
